WITH g AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (grid_cd) grid_cd, bndry_geom, ctr_lat, ctr_lot FROM parking.tb_grid WHERE grid_sz = #{gridSz} ORDER BY grid_cd, sgg_cd ), hit AS ( SELECT g.grid_cd, g.bndry_geom, g.ctr_lat, g.ctr_lot, c.cvlcpt_type_cd FROM g JOIN parking.tb_cvlcpt c ON c.geom && g.bndry_geom AND ST_Contains(g.bndry_geom, c.geom) WHERE c.lat IS NOT NULL AND c.cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99' AND c.ocrn_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND c.ocrn_dt < #{endDtExcl} AND c.emd_cd = #{emdCd} AND c.emd_cd LIKE #{sggCd} || '%' ), agg AS ( SELECT grid_cd, bndry_geom, ctr_lat, ctr_lot, count(*) AS anls_vl FROM hit GROUP BY grid_cd, bndry_geom, ctr_lat, ctr_lot
), typed AS ( SELECT grid_cd, cvlcpt_type_cd, count(*) AS cnt FROM hit GROUP BY grid_cd, cvlcpt_type_cd ), top2 AS ( SELECT grid_cd, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'cvlcptTypeCd', cvlcpt_type_cd, 'cvlcptTypeNm', cd_nm, 'cnt', cnt ) ORDER BY rn) AS dtl_json FROM ( SELECT t.grid_cd, t.cvlcpt_type_cd, t.cnt, m.cd_nm, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.grid_cd ORDER BY t.cnt DESC, t.cvlcpt_type_cd) AS rn FROM typed t JOIN parking.tb_com_cd m ON m.group_cd = 'CVLCPT_TYPE_CD' AND m.cd_vl = t.cvlcpt_type_cd ) z WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY grid_cd ) SELECT a.grid_cd, a.anls_vl, a.ctr_lat, a.ctr_lot, ST_AsGeoJSON(a.bndry_geom) AS ring_json, t.dtl_json::text AS dtl_json, ad.emd_nm, CASE WHEN zc.zone_nm_src IN ('POI', 'REVERSE_GEOCODE') THEN zc.zone_nm END AS cache_zone_nm FROM agg a LEFT JOIN top2 t ON t.grid_cd = a.grid_cd LEFT JOIN parking.tb_admdst ad ON ST_Contains(ad.bndry_geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(a.ctr_lot, a.ctr_lat), 4326)) LEFT JOIN parking.tb_zone_nm_cache zc ON zc.lat_key = round(a.ctr_lat, 5) AND zc.lot_key = round(a.ctr_lot, 5) ORDER BY a.anls_vl DESC, a.grid_cd

SELECT to_char((SELECT min(ocrn_dt) FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_bgng_ymd, to_char((SELECT max(ocrn_dt) FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_end_ymd

SELECT z.lat_key, z.lot_key, z.zone_nm FROM unnest(string_to_array(#{latKeys}, ',')::numeric[], string_to_array(#{lotKeys}, ',')::numeric[]) AS k(lat_key, lot_key) JOIN parking.tb_zone_nm_cache z ON z.lat_key = k.lat_key AND z.lot_key = k.lot_key WHERE z.zone_nm_src IN ('POI', 'REVERSE_GEOCODE')
